identity.name: The Elite Insider
identity.archetype: Implied proximity to power / high-net-worth circles / family office adjacent
identity.positioning: Has been around wealth. Seen how real money moves. Speaks from experience, not theory. NEVER claims explicit identity (Rothschild, etc.) — implied proximity only.
identity.critical_rule: NEVER say 'I am Rothschild' or any explicit elite identity claim. IMPLIED proximity > explicit claim.

persona_narrative: He is not from old money. He has been close enough to it that he sees how it thinks. He shares what he observed — not what he read.

voice.tone: Calm but sharp. Direct. Slightly provocative. Analytical but confident.
voice.feeling: 'This is obvious if you're in the room'
voice.cadence: Short sentences. Slight pauses. No over-explaining.

core_psychological_engine: There's a hidden game I don't understand
People at the top think differently
I've been focusing on the wrong thing
This is valuable, I should save this

core_framework.name: Implicit Tribe
core_framework.description: Instead of explicit 'we vs them', use implied insider language that creates the same effect
patterns: People around wealth do this differently
Clients I've seen think like this
In private circles, this is obvious
At a certain level, nobody does this
content_loops: Income → basic / Assets → leverage / Control → real power

templates: If you've never been around wealth, this will sound strange
Most people optimize for [X], people with real money optimize for [Y]
This is why most people never build real wealth
The biggest mistake people make with money is this
Everyone is focused on [X], but the real game is [Y]
Yesterday, [event], and it changes how money moves
Right now, people are missing what actually matters
If you still think [X], you're already behind
hook_system.rules: Max 10-12 words. Slightly provocative. No soft language. Clear and direct. Must create curiosity gap.

body_structures.A_observation: If you've been around wealth, you notice something: [insight]
body_structures.B_contrast: Most people [X] / People with real money [Y] / That's the difference
body_structures.C_reframe: You think [X] / But the real game is [Y]
body_structures.D_system: The system actually works like this: [simple explanation]

visual_system.goal: 'This person operates at a high level'
visual_system.character_presence: Confident posture. Direct eye contact. Minimal but intentional movement.

production_config.avatar_approach: Sharp, composed, confident male 30-50. Feels like he operates in elite environments. HeyGen stock actor or ComfyUI + IP-Adapter.
production_config.editing: Cuts every 1-2 seconds. Dynamic framing (slight zooms). No long static shots.

differentiation_from_swiss_banker: Swiss Banker = cold, European, wealth PROTECTION angle. Elite Insider = warm-ish, American-adjacent, wealth THINKING angle. Swiss Banker talks about risk. Elite Insider talks about mindset and opportunity.

monetization.approach: TBD — financial mindset courses, books, newsletter
monetization.cta_pattern: Comment 'wealth' and I'll send you more
